component.name: OpenBeach
component.summary: Offline beach volleyball scoresheet with a LAN server for the tablets

description.p: OpenBeach is an electronic scoresheet for beach volleyball, made for the scorer's table, from the makers of OpenVolley eScoresheet.

It runs fully offline and doubles as a server on the local network: the referee and livescore tablets and the court displays connect to it over the same Wi-Fi, with no internet and no accounts. It runs next to OpenVolley eScoresheet on the same computer (OpenBeach uses ports 5174 and 8081).

ul.li: Teams of two, coin toss and the service order
Rally-by-rally scoring with undo and court switches
Timeouts, sanctions, signatures and the scoresheet PDF
Referee and livescore views and court displays on other devices

description.p: Languages: English, German, Swiss German, French, Italian.

screenshot.caption: The start screen: a new match or a restored one

description.p: First release of the OpenBeach desktop app: the beach volleyball scoretable and a LAN server for the referee and livescore tablets and the court displays.
